decision: Approve the image-fit convention (fit) for PhotoFrame without changing any existing component contract.

userStatements.provenance: odd/tasks/attachment-photo-frame-amendments.md L2 (2026-11-20): acceptance of the PhotoFrame v0.5 fit amendment, including PF-1 (approve image-fit / fit)
Implementation plan approval (2026-11-20): docs/components/photo-frame/v0.5/implementation-plan.md, which records image-fit with this approval record

limits: Binds only the image-fit convention payload below; ratio, focalPoint, variant and imageCaption keep their existing meanings and approvals.
Every existing PhotoFrame API is unchanged; no migration is implied.

convention.name: fit
convention.meaning: How a replaced image is scaled inside its already-reserved viewport: fill and crop (cover) or show whole and letterbox (contain).
convention.whenToUse: A media component exposes a finite set of static scaling policies independent of its proportion and crop alignment.
convention.avoid: Reserved proportion, absolute width/height, crop alignment, Material tone, arbitrary inline CSS.
